subject.title: feat: add live-validated Zoom meeting guest plugin

question: Should Zoom guest meeting automation ship as a bundled OpenClaw plugin, or should this browser- and permission-sensitive transport be distributed as an official external plugin instead?
rationale: The code is structured as a plugin and is disabled by default, but bundling creates a maintained browser-control, media-permission, and node-audio surface that repository policy treats as an owner/product decision.

options.title: Approve bundled Zoom plugin
options.body: Keep the plugin in the core distribution after the owner approves its permissions, node-command boundary, and live proof, while leaving it disabled by default.

options.title: Publish as an official external plugin
options.body: Move the Zoom-specific package, dependencies, documentation, and support lifecycle outside the core distribution while retaining only generic meeting-runtime seams in core.

recommendation.title: Approve bundled Zoom plugin
recommendation.body: Keep the plugin in the core distribution after the owner approves its permissions, node-command boundary, and live proof, while leaving it disabled by default.

likelyOwner.reason: The current implementation, live-validation claims, and proposed bundled distribution all originate in this feature branch.
